Hi Lisa / Amaya team — thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers and references below; I'll also populate the questionnaire spreadsheet and upload the Redwood security brochure.

1) SOC 2
- Status: Redwood Inference completed SOC 2 Type I (security) in 2025; Type II audit in progress with reporting period through 2026-05-31. Expected final Type II report delivery: Q3 2026 (targeting late August).
- Immediate: we can share our SOC 2 Type I report and an interim controls summary today.

2) Data deletion SLAs (primary vs backups)
- Primary data deletion (user/customer data stored in our application and primary datastore): default completion within 72 hours of a validated deletion request. This includes deletion from active databases and internal indexes.
- Backups/replicas: backups are retained for 30 days in standard configuration; we retain daily snapshots for 30 days and weekly snapshots for 90 days for disaster recovery. Deletions from backups follow a removal schedule during snapshot rotation and cannot be guaranteed immediate unless we put a special retention-removal run in place. For customers with stricter needs we offer a contractual SLA: backup purge within 7-14 days post-request (subject to provisioning and verification) — this requires an addendum and, in some cases, dedicated retention buckets.

3) Log retention and immutability
- Application logs: default retention 90 days.
- Audit logs (security/auth/access): retained 365 days and write-once/read-many (WORM) enabled at the storage layer for compliance customers. Audit logs can be exported in bulk (CSV/JSON) on request and via secure S3 export with appropriate access controls.

4) Backups and backups of backups
- Backups are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit. Access to backup artifacts is limited to a small number of ops engineers and logged. For customers requiring customer-managed keys (CMKs) we support KMS integration for Private deployments.

5) Data subject requests (GDPR)
- We support data export and deletion flows; typical turnaround: export within 48 hours, delete (primary) within 72 hours as noted. For deletion from backups we follow the backup purge schedule above and can provide attestations once purge runs complete.

6) Next steps / deliverables
- I'll populate the questionnaire and send initial answers + Amaya_Security_Questionnaire_answers_v1.xlsx by EOD today.
- We'll attach our SOC 2 Type I and the Redwood_Security_Brochure_v3.pdf.
- If Amaya needs a contractual backup purge SLA (7-14 days), please flag and we can involve Contracting to draft an addendum; timeline for contracting varies depending on legal review.

If you'd like a quick 20-min session to walk through the answers, I can make time this afternoon.

Thanks,
